data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella for 2034? The first thing to check is the marbella yacht charter minimum age policy 2034. The rule is simple: renters must be 18 or older, but there’s no age limit for passengers. That means families with kids, mixed-age groups, and even solo travellers can book—as long as the person making the reservation meets the age requirement. Below, we break down the exact rules, which boats suit your group, and what to expect when you step aboard in Puerto Banús.

Minimum Age for Renters: 18+ Only

To charter any boat from our fleet, the named renter must be at least 18 years old on the day of departure. You’ll need to show a valid passport or EU national ID at check-in. This applies to all vessels—from the compact Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the superyacht-class Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). There is no upper age limit.

No Minimum Age for Passengers

Passengers of any age are welcome. Infants, toddlers, teenagers, and seniors can all come along. Life jackets are available in all sizes—just let us know the ages of your group when you book via WhatsApp so we can prepare the right gear. This makes our charters ideal for family days out, multi-generational trips, or birthday celebrations with younger guests.

Which Boats Are Best for Families with Kids?

If you’re bringing children, stability and shade matter. Our Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) catamaran offers a wide, stable deck and plenty of covered seating. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) has a large flybridge with sunshade and a saloon with air conditioning. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is a solid choice with a spacious cockpit. All boats include a licensed skipper, so you can focus on the fun.

Age Policy for Jet Skis and Water Toys

On charters that include a jet ski—like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax)—riders must be at least 16 years old and hold a valid jet ski licence, or be directly supervised by a licensed adult. Life jackets are mandatory. For younger kids, we can arrange towable inflatables or paddleboards (subject to availability and conditions).

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Booking Process for Under-18 Groups

If your group includes under-18s, the booking must be made by someone 18 or older. That person will be the responsible renter and must be present at check-in. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance via WhatsApp—especially during peak summer (June–September). You can browse our full fleet here and message us with your preferred date and group size.

Local Regulations in Marbella and Puerto Banús

Marbella’s port authorities enforce a strict 18+ rule for charter renters. No exceptions. All skippers are licensed by the Spanish Merchant Marine and carry full liability insurance. The waters off Puerto Banús, Cabopino, and Estepona are calm and safe for all ages—water temperature averages 24°C in summer, making swimming and snorkelling easy for kids.

You must be at least 18 years old to book and be the named renter. Valid passport or EU ID is required at check-in. There is no upper age limit for renters or passengers.

Yes, children of any age are welcome as passengers. Life jackets are available on board for all sizes. Just let us know ages when booking so we can prepare appropriate safety gear.

No licence is needed because a licensed skipper is included on every charter. You just relax and enjoy – the skipper handles navigation, mooring, and safety.

No minimum group size – you can book for 1 person. Maximum capacity varies by boat: from 5 pax on smaller speedboats up to 12 pax on larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94.

Yes, under-18s are fine as passengers. For mixed-age groups, we recommend boats with shaded decks and stable hulls, like the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Lagoon 380 catamaran.

What happens if I’m under 18 but want to book?

The booking must be made by someone 18 or older. That person will be the responsible renter on the day. All other passengers can be any age.

Are there any age restrictions for jet skis or water toys?

Jet skis (included free on Mangusta 80 charters) require the rider to be 16+ with a valid licence or under direct supervision of a licensed adult. Life jackets must be worn at all times.
